observation: K07 cannot pass for actors of a seeded Auth tenant that the lane Platform does not know (97c5): tenant login returns 401 and `up` aborts. `up` has no hook between launch and K07, so the documented remedy "fix the input and start again from up" is impossible without editing the flow. Known since A12 VER-02 SOP-22 §7.5 but not carried into v1.2.
suggested_change: Either seed the Platform tenant record in K05/K07 (lane DB only) or add a declared pre-K07 harness hook to `up`.

observation: On an aborted `up`, the K07 run log lives in W/logs and K11 deletes W, so the failure reason (why 401) is lost; only the status survives in identities-aN.json.
suggested_change: Copy W/logs/run-*.log through K08 redact into E/raw before K11 removes W.

observation: After `supervisor abort`, K11 checked PIDs that were still exiting: `ps -o command=` was empty, so five rows read "SKIPPED: pid no longer belongs to lane" instead of stopped/already-exited. Ports were free (PASS) and no process remained.
suggested_change: Re-check kill -0 after a short wait before the ownership test, or record "exiting".

observation: raw/processes.tsv (and raw/binary-sha256.txt) are append-only across attempts and are not reset; after an aborted attempt K09 evaluates the dead attempt's PIDs too and fails although every live row is match/listening.
suggested_change: Attempt-suffix processes.tsv/binary-sha256.txt, or have K09 bind only the PIDs in the current W/pids.tsv.

observation: All six .NET services ignored SIGTERM for the 20 s window and were KILLED-after-timeout (both lanes). Not a FAIL row; K11 PASS.
suggested_change: Wait up to the host ShutdownTimeout (30 s default) or signal the supervisor child's process group.

observation: `seal` calls ek_require_env, which recreates EK_WORK; the supervisor then writes run-seal-a1.log into W/logs, so the workspace K11 removed exists again (log only).
suggested_change: Do not mkdir EK_WORK in seal/down, or log the seal to the fallback folder.

observation: K01/K03/K04 write fixed file names (source-*.tsv, PORTS-before.tsv, effective-config-*.json, SOURCE-TREE-MANIFEST.tsv); a second `up` into the same evidence folder overwrites attempt 1's copies (G3 covers only some files).
suggested_change: Attempt-suffix these outputs or refuse a non-empty evidence folder.

observation: Harness args must each match [A-Za-z0-9._:/=@,+-]; the supervisor correctly refused an argument with spaces (operator error in zsh, retried with separate arguments). The refused request left no COMMANDS.tsv row.
suggested_change: Consider one COMMANDS row per refused request.
